moments.text: IR view with crosshair over a shoreline and a long pier-like structure; black boxes mask the edges. The view drifts off the shore by 6.5 s.
The image steps brighter and a faint white dash appears lower left of the crosshair; it wanders around the centre as the sensor follows.
A dark shape with a short smeared trail crosses the lower frame left to right in under 2 s, vanishing behind the lower-right black box.
Seen closer, the bright dash is a short row of two or three dots, drifting around the crosshair rather than held on it.
The dots are out of view; at 2:01.5 they slide in along the bottom edge, then sit right of the crosshair after a quick swing.
Black, blotchy and white frames for ~0.4 s, then a wider, brighter view with diagonal streaks and a dark curve at the left edge; the dots shrink to a speck.
Another glitch, then a closer view: one bright dot near the crosshair. Around 4:34 a dashed box reading 30M briefly frames it.
Clearest stretch: a tight cluster of two or three bright dots that the crosshair keeps chasing. At 9:55 a box reading 20M frames it.
The cluster is gone. After another glitch the view widens to bright streaks with a dark curve lower left; only faint specks remain.
A burst of white and black frames, then a closer view: the dots are back upper left and drift around the crosshair again.
Zoom step: the dots merge into one larger bright spot below left of the crosshair; it later slips out near the bottom edge and back.
A last glitch, then a wider streaky view; a tiny spot sits just below the crosshair, then is lost as the image brightens to the end.
